title: PrisonPearls
description: by priming ender pearls you can trap a player in the nether by killing them
body:
You can exile players by killing them while holding a Primed Pearl in your inventory.

Primed Pearls can be obtained by holding an Ender Pearl and running _/prime_. When used, the Primed Pearl is converted into an Exile Pearl.

Exiled players recieve an Exiled Pearl with information about the duration of their exile,

they can also run 
/getcoords to get the current location of their Exile Pearl to possibly retrieve it and destroy it to end their Exile

When an Exile Pearl is thrown the exiled player is teleported to the location the pearl lands

You can customize the base exile duration, whether it can be extended ( /extendexile ), how much it can be extended by, and what percentage of the base time must remain before an Exile Pearl can be extended in config.json.

You can also choose whether the exile time is tracked as a timer or a timestamp. A timer only counts down while the server is online, whereas a timestamp continues to count down even when the server is offline.

This plugin was made for Big World, a CIV server which you can join here https://discord.gg/8XYPDdY6gB
please note that this isnt a support server for this plugin but rather its own thing
